from scipy.optimize import least_squares
t=df['t'].values; A=df['A'].values; y=df['dA_dt'].values
edges=np.arange(0.5,10.01,0.5)
for lo in edges[:-1]:
    m=(t>=lo)&(t<lo+0.5)
    if m.sum()<8: continue
    f=lambda p: p[0]+p[1]*A[m]**p[2]-y[m]

        p0=rng.uniform(0.1,3,k)
